name: Saitou Hajime
source:
Hobby: Bathing Sunlight

Although he is the youngest member in the Shinsengumi, Hajime is actually the leader of team three. He doesn't speak much in normal times, but he will become all aggressive and talkative once he wields the blade.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/baku.html]English official site[/url]]
